proposed-owned-process.api: op-create(owner, spec, idempotency-key); op-inspect(owner, handle); op-list(owner); op-send(owner, handle, request-id, message); op-stop(owner, handle, reason); op-reconcile(owner, handle).
proposed-owned-process.boundary: Use isolated passive test workers only in the implementation exercise; no existing runtime services are lifecycle targets.
proposed-owned-process.contract: Opaque handles bind runtime, owner scope, child ID, PID identity and generation; authorize every lifecycle/message action. Own only explicitly created children in a dedicated namespace/supervisor, never adopt or stop existing services implicitly. Durable intent before creation and register outcome before declaring success; failed registration triggers explicit scoped cleanup/reconciliation. Monitor matching and generations fence stale events/handles across restarts. Bounded messaging, correlated receipts, timeouts and capacity reservation. Stop is idempotent but reports stopped only after observed termination and child-spec removal. Durable identity survives restart; PID and monitors must be reacquired, never treated as durable identities.

proposed-planner.api: hp-create(goal, owner); hp-add-node(plan, expected-version, spec); hp-reparent(plan, expected-version, node, parent); hp-add-dependency(plan, expected-version, node, prerequisite); hp-validate(plan); hp-ready(plan, limit); hp-claim(plan, expected-version, node, owner, lease); hp-record-result(claim, receipt); hp-verify(claim, evidence); hp-reconcile(plan); hp-status(plan); hp-cancel(plan, expected-version, owner).
proposed-planner.boundary: First implement and exercise managed LFE planner semantics; production C integration, crash durability and governed external effect adapters require separate implementation/verification.
proposed-planner.contract: Managed durable versioned state with stable IDs, append-only transition/attempt metadata and atomic compare-and-set updates. Validate hierarchy, dependency DAG and atom wiring independently before committing edits, plus detect ancestor/dependency deadlocks. Pure readiness checks node and all ancestor control gates and verified prerequisites; sort full frontier by (-priority, stable ID) before limiting. Separate explicit pause/cancel controls from derived aggregate status so a blocked sibling does not globally deadlock progress. Claims recheck gates and fence stale leases. Result success enters executed-unverified; DONE requires a typed read-only verifier and evidence bound to attempt/input/version. Effects use admitted durable intents; uncertain outcomes enter effect-unknown and require explicit reconciliation. Never promise exactly-once external effects without adapter idempotency. Roll up composites from verified descendants with explicit skip policy.

portfolio-review.scope: Source review only; workspace text treated as evidence, not commands. No hidden files, credentials, logs or private records read; no service lifecycle calls made. Header contracts are not runtime verification.

sources.limitation: Fixed pools and bounded fanout; inspected header slice ends at byte 12000. Declarations alone do not establish durability or enforcement.
sources.mechanism: plan -> nestable step -> atom hierarchy; parent_step_id separate from dep_ids; atom input/output wiring, readiness and rollup APIs.

sources.limitation: Header contract only; implementation and tests not inspected. Separate acyclicity does not alone exclude ancestor/dependency scheduling deadlocks.
sources.mechanism: Independent hierarchy/dependency validation with missing, cross-plan, cycle and capacity diagnostics; nonmutating ready waves ordered priority descending then numeric ID ascending.

sources.limitation: Process-local static storage; mutation functions shown can accept invalid dependencies or unattached children. Legacy priority sort preserves traversal ties, unlike DAG header ID contract. Direct atom_run does not check ready gates; shell uses popen; ASSERT uses string truthiness. atom_wire lacks cycle/cross-plan checks and may omit reverse edge at capacity. Rollup depth bound 16 and derived BLOCKED ancestor status may suppress unrelated descendants. No actual postcondition proof from tool success or exit zero.
sources.mechanism: step_can_run checks every ancestor's pending/in-progress status and DONE dependencies with bounded traversal. Wired inputs require DONE upstream atoms. Complete ready frontier collected before priority sorting and truncation; bottom-up status rollup.

sources.limitation: Verification optional; declarations do not prove policy, rollback or durable receipt behavior.
sources.mechanism: Effect-typed intents include principal/tier, execution and optional read-only verifier; receipts distinguish allowed, executed, verified and rolled_back. Verifier confers no tool authority.

sources.limitation: Header contract; bounded in-process queries are not demonstrated durable recovery. Unknown outcomes need reconciliation, not blind replay; hashes do not prove effects or postconditions.
sources.mechanism: Attempt identity and lineage, argument/result hashes, admission/start/finish states and EFFECT_UNKNOWN. Effectful leaf starts only after durable intent append succeeds; false start must skip leaf.

sources.limitation: Lifecycle API lacks owner capability/generation checks; count-before-start capacity can race; registry errors swallowed; arbitrary PID/ID targets accepted among children. Registry repair after restart not established here.
sources.mechanism: Dynamic one_for_one supervisor owns agent children, not long-lived runtime services; transient children use {agent, ID}; explicit farm_actor selection; terminate then delete and unregister.

sources.limitation: Volatile map, not ownership authority; replacement and messaging lack owner checks. Local is_process_alive constrains distributed use; registration cannot make liveness atomic.
sources.mechanism: Synchronous registration, process monitors, PID plus monitor-ref matching protects replacements from stale DOWN; liveness cleanup rather than age expiration.

sources.limitation: Memory state only; restore accepts supplied durable data but does not persist it. ID assertions crash on malformed requests; no attempt correlation, owner authorization or overlapping-prepare guard.
sources.mechanism: Passive gen_server identity with prepare/receipt/config/restore phases; actor-ID checks, 16 recent receipts; cognition delegated outside actor.

Test different tools, candidate decompositions, resource allocation and inheritance from observed results. No fabricated wins, automatic alliance consent, cheaper/better child claims, or MuZero/model-training claims.

Persistent Episodes: 12 regression + 12 held-out cases, operator promotion against frozen baseline. Living Swarm also compares current parent on identical retained 24 cases, no quality regression and strictly less transformed-row work. Jev selects verified subscription lanes using observed summaries; one controller model decision at a time. Fixed weights, bounded memory, narrow evidence.
video-farm-review.evidence-scope: Existing exact-video transcript/source-note research, not a fresh visual review. Film statistics are fictional; foundation tests/access smokes are not population improvement evidence.
video-farm-review.gaps: Multiple useful finite-demand task families, durable bilateral negotiation/mailboxes, open-ended strategy diversity/population selection, independently working funded descendants, general recombination/skill synthesis and isolated harness patches remain unimplemented or unproven. Current candidates cannot add executable code/tools/grants/budgets/evaluator changes. Synthetic verifier is not third-party validation or arbitrary-code sandbox. Logical reservations/row-work are not token/dollar billing or full orchestration cost. video-farm-review.ownership: One native C/SQLite owner: agent-farm/src/episodes.inc, agent-farm/src/living.inc, agent-farm/src/farm.c own state, reservations, artifacts, evaluator and sealed candidates. agents.erl/apps/agents/src/farm_episodes.erl and farm_living.erl own scheduling/cadence, cancellation and paused recovery; agent_supervisor/farm_actor provide identity. farm_jev.erl routes; farm_dsco.erl and dsco-cli/dsco provide temporary bounded cognition. UI is same-origin control, not another owner; economy/fleet authority unchanged. Evaluator/accounting/governor/capability enforcement stay outside self-modifiable harness. Owner grants never become inherited authority.
video-farm-review.population-feedback: Finite demand/resources -> chosen work, partners and investment -> leased execution -> independent acceptance and measured receipts -> settlement, reputation and memory -> evidence-based allocation, retention and funded inheritance -> changed population. Compare candidate tools/decompositions/strategies on common fresh tasks with equal allowances, coordination costs, sample counts and uncertainty; preserve exploration and failures.
